conversation: Implement the feature described in .agents/features/workflow-retry-and-automatic-retries.md, incorporating the decisions from this discussion. Key decisions: make retry/resume/run targeting very clean and easy to use; add attempt-specific events so failed attempts that will be retried are distinct from terminal step.failed/workflow.failed; use event identity/replay position rather than stepId alone; default automatic retries should be maxAttempts 2 for safe transient/pre-dispatch errors such as agent_provider_spawn_error; if a provider process actually started, assume it may have done side effects and do not auto-retry unless a future structured pre-dispatch failure proves it is safe; add interactive stepkit runs; stepkit retry and stepkit continue should support no-arg interactive target selection/confirmation, while non-interactive usage should require explicit target or fail safely; stepkit runs should show all active runs, the most recent 10 failed runs unless failures are over a week old or were retried and completed successfully, and all runs somewhere separate/bottom; retry config should support global defaults, workflow config, and later/where appropriate individual step override, with precedence step > workflow > global > built-in default; put step retry controls as execution options rather than prompt options; avoid --step in v1 and always retry latest unresolved failure, with possible future --failure-event eventId; manual retry should preserve old failed artifacts with a new attempt/artifact position, while automatic safe retry can reuse when no meaningful work started; update resume internals to latest-unresolved-failure behavior and remove legacy resume code/UX rather than preserving compatibility; old --resume can be removed, not kept as alias. Do not update the handoff doc first; implement story-by-story through the workflow.
